review.note: Release 0.6.0 requires close_owner callers to pass their existing absolute cleanup deadline. Generated snapshot consumers update through normal sync; explicit callers select their phase deadline, with no implicit poll-deadline fallback. run_command keeps its API and no application data migration is needed. POSIX diagnostic writers preserve inherited descriptor flags and register before spawn; Windows uses isolated base interpreters and Job-assigned start gates. Writing, reap, scope removal and recovery replay share existing bounds. V2 callers finish optional output before evidence publication and never start another writer or publish passing evidence after unknown cleanup. All pre-owner stdlib launcher modes, including source discovery, normal/review owners, recovery and diagnostics, use -I -S -B; actual owned children retain normal dependencies. The diagnostic launcher shares existing PID/signal/receipt management. Process/scope/diagnostic targets, standalone/managed publication failure and a real exited-group/unclosed-obligation negative control passed. The complete affected merge workflow/command modules passed 152 cases in 479.53 seconds, including all 16 interruption combinations and real active sitecustomize/.pth controls for four startup entry modes. Ruff, formatter, strict mypy and Markdown checks pass. A limited independent launcher-boundary check found no remaining concrete defect; this does not replace formal full-repository review or the exact-candidate gate. Native Windows remains a separate platform CI target. No dependency bounds, pins or runtime dependencies changed. Fresh registry candidates match the already reviewed 0.5.0 set: hatchling 1.32.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, ruff 0.17.1 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3; all satisfy declared ranges and Python candidates support 3.14. Identical upstream release-note conclusions still apply, including https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.1; no preview/PYI/PERF rules are enabled. The normally resolved repository environment uses Python 3.14.1, command-local uv 0.13.0 and these candidates with project version 0.6.0.
